observed_decision_effect.question: What locally authorized Standing effect is evidenced at the bound root?

prospective_safe_next_action.question: What action may the successor safely take next without claiming or causing unsupported local acceptance?

temporal_response_semantics.cross_field_rule: Historical effect and prospective action are scored separately; no field named only authority_action is permitted.

required_response: bounded changed, reassess, and remains-valid dispositions
repository-local accepted state at each bound root
entry_gates: deterministic fixture, custody, semantic, and packet checks pass
public discrimination check remains authority-irreducible by construction
separately authorized independent open pilot observes at least 2 of 12 Git/documents failures and at least 6 of 12 Git/documents exact passes
open pilot exposes no response-schema or runtime defect
fresh held-out real correction families are selected and source-bound after the open pilot
independent methodology and custody review returns exact PASS
stop_lines: confirmatory_freeze_allowed=false until every entry gate passes
no participant or provider call without separate authorization
no scoring or protected-key creation or opening during open qualification
no positive structure, governance/inheritance, or total-lift claim from public fixtures
no Protocol, Core, Repository-authority, Decision, or Standing change without an independently demonstrated semantic defect
